description: Read the state and outcome of a business call you placed with call_business (an outbound call; the calls your own answering line took are in get_line_calls), using its task_id. Call it again until the state is final: queued, dialing and in_call are still in progress; completed, no_answer, voicemail, refused and failed are final; input_required means the business asked a question that answer_call_question can answer within 45 seconds. Requires direct:tasks and ownership of the call (another account’s task_id returns Not found). Returns {task_id, state, outcome, duration_seconds, transcript, answers, summary, cost {credits}}, plus pending_question {question, expires_at} while a question waits. Changes nothing, starts no call and is safe to repeat.
name: get_call_result
title: Read your business call result
